claims.description: The source baseline, exact current base, bounded file set, and complete verification surfaces are recorded for this delivery.
All externally visible consent-ordering variants are covered, including deterministic exits, exact-claim restoration, both restoration-failure shapes, and one active-consent grader dispatch.
The structural guard now classifies retention as a granular service-owned boundary after deterministic cooldown and claim exits while retaining route-owned metering.
Focused red, candidate green, production-only revert red, exact restore green, and routed validation evidence are preserved with commands and results.
The diff remains limited to the six authorized collision files and lifecycle evidence; no schema, policy, provider, metering, or deployment surface changed.
